knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
translations.bsb: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
translations.kjv: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
translations.asv: And they that are of Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts thereof.
